title: Understanding the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix, often denoted as X, includes all the input features for each observation. Since there are $$400$$ flight records, think about how many rows the matrix should have. Also, consider the number of columns based on the features provided.

title: Including the Intercept
text: Remember that the design matrix X includes an intercept term. This means that even if there are $$9$$ numerical features, the matrix will have an additional column for the intercept. How does this affect the total number of columns?

title: Determine the Number of Rows
text: How many rows should the design matrix X have if there are $$400$$ flight records?

title: Determine the Number of Columns
